editorial.blurb: Piccolo Sogno delivers exceptional handmade Italian pasta and wood-fired pizzas in a chic, Italy-inspired setting that makes every meal feel special.
editorial.insiderTip: Ask for the vodka cream pasta even if it's not on the menu—staff will happily make one of their best versions for you.

topDishes.note: Hand-rolled and impossibly fresh, described as some of the best ever had
Delicate ricotta and truffle filling with amazing taste
Piping hot, falls off the bone, tender and juicy
